notes.title: Weapons and Tools Wheel Selection!
notes.content:
Hello!
Thank you so much for your interest in ShootOut(SystemD)!
I'll continue to upgrade the gameplay, fonctionalities and user experience as far as I can go!

This first patch is introducing Wheel Selection for weapons and tools. Input has not changed:
[list]
[*] D-pad UP or MouseWheel UP to chose Weapons & Granades
[*] D-Pad Down or MouseWheel Down to chose Drones
[/list]

Please, continue to send feedback, it is material of great value to improve the experience for everyone!
